_about: v1: the drawing already shows how a line is delivered, and the English is lettered into the same balloon, so a guide says what the type means and what the English needs for it; the Korean sets the intensity. Markers only where the Korean or the type calls for them.

types.think_bubble: a thought balloon (a tail of small circles)
types.spiked_bubble: a balloon ringed by thin spikes
types.standalone_text: lettering on the art, without a balloon
types.background_text: text that is part of the scene

guides.speech_bubble: ordinary spoken dialogue. Use idiomatic spoken English at the same register as the Korean (polite, casual or rough).
guides.think_bubble: an unspoken thought. Write it as inner voice: informal, not addressed to anyone. Trail off with '...' only where the Korean trails off.
guides.cloud_bubble: light, playful or affectionate speech. Keep the wording soft and friendly; use '~' only where the Korean has one.
guides.wiggle_bubble: shaky speech: fear, weakness, embarrassment or hesitation. Let the wording sound unsure where the Korean hesitates; at most one stutter or '...', and only if the Korean has a break.
guides.scream_bubble: the line is shouted. Make it forceful and short; end with '!' (two at most). Do not write it in capitals: the lettering shows the shout.
guides.spiked_bubble: a sharp inner reaction or impulse, closer to a thought than to speech: shock, anger, sudden realisation. Keep it short and abrupt.
guides.hexagon_bubble: a voice through a device, magic or a machine (phone, AI, spell, broadcast). Keep the speaker's own wording; clipped and impersonal only if a machine speaks.
guides.square_bubble: narration or a voice-over. Use clear written English in a consistent tense, without chatty fillers.
guides.system_bubble: a game interface message. Use terse interface English: title case for names of skills, items, quests and stats; keep brackets, numbers and symbols exactly.
guides.standalone_text: lettering drawn straight onto the art, often an off-panel voice or a short exclamation. Keep it as short as the Korean.
guides.background_text: a sign, screen, label, book or message in the scene. Translate it as that object would read in English: short, no added punctuation.
guides.title_panel: a series or chapter title. Short, in title case; keep wordplay where possible.
guides.sfx_sound: a sound effect or drawn action word. Give one English comics sound or action word (BANG, THUD, GRAB, SHFF) in capitals, about as long as the Korean; no punctuation.
